shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone monument
paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both are upright monuments bearing shallow relief with squarish rounded cartouche-like signs, symmetrical paired motifs about a vertical axis, and disc/circular elements, and both use a schematic, low-relief, outline-with-interior-detail convention. But A is dominated by a single large frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, torso, arms and a chest disc, whereas B is an all-over grid of repeated rectangular sign-blocks in columns with no single dominant figure, so the compositional scheme and relationships differ substantially.
